neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * [Fast mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode) is out of research preview for Claude Opus 5.5, and you no longer need to request access. Requests to Claude Opus 5.5 no longer require the `fast-mode-2026-02-01` beta header, and requests that still send it keep working. Claude Opus 5.5 now has a default fast mode rate limit in the Start, Build, and Scale usage tiers. Fast mode for Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 4.8 remains in research preview. Keep sending the beta header with fast mode requests to those models.
